## Limits And Additional Notes

- Source cases are the review targets; actual comparison/target owners are listed without inventing owners for source-only cases.
- Frozen source snapshots outside this worktree remain bound by their original queue paths and SHA256 in evidence.json. Captured primary artifacts retain actual retrieval timestamps; no shared cache reuse confers approval.
- 24 proposal mappings have canonical-label confirmation; MICRO:0000520 adapter unavailable. MeSH concept terms pass the current local label/schema checks; downstream consumer compatibility remains a coordinator obligation.
- No maintained YAML, canonical SSSOM, unified snapshot, semantic review, companion selectors or publication inputs were edited. No merges, extra external sessions or downstream builds were performed.
- All changed owner bytes withdraw inherited positive approval. Existing REJECTED/WITHHOLD/source-material restrictions and unresolved supplied-form/version/quantity boundaries remain.

- assessment_id: case-000
  area: identity
  topic: Fe2(SO4)3・nH2O
  outcome: supported
  summary: 'TOGO M1344 and JCM1250 name ferric sulfate with an unspecified hydration
    number. The typed source GMO_001304 agrees with iron(III) sulfate n-hydrate. The
    source does not choose a fixed hydrate. CHEBI:131387 was explicitly rejected as
    an exact candidate: its definition and formula specify the monohydrate despite
    its generic-looking label. Retain the variable-hydrate owner and any asymmetric
    parent relation; do not equate it to the anhydrous substance.'
  details: 'All 1 original occurrences were reviewed in their complete frozen recipe
    contexts. Evidence applies to the exact preserved source label ''Fe2(SO4)3・nH2O'';
    source component, stock, salt, hydration and charge scopes are interpreted only
    as stated in the case reasoning. No inherited hold or downstream identity authorization
    is removed. Next requirement: A supplier or source statement fixing n is required
    for a fixed-hydrate identity; complete owner payload review is still required
    for release.'

  area: identity
  topic: Ce(NO3)3 x 6 H2O

  summary: The five occurrences consistently specify Ce(NO3)3 with six waters, including
    MediaDive compound1587 in solutions5819 and5825 and DSMZ media1738,1739,1741.
    This is cerium(III) nitrate hexahydrate, not anhydrous cerium nitrate. The source-specific
    raw formula is an unambiguous spelling of the same material as candidate owner
    CeNO33_X_6_H2O. Subset C owns the coordinated CAS-grounded promotion proposal;
    this assessment adds no competing owner bytes.

- assessment_id: case-042
  area: identity
  topic: Zinc
  outcome: unknown
  summary: MediaDB compound38 explicitly represents Zinc as BiGGzn2, CHEBI29105, Zn2+/Zn(II),
    and the two complete TAP recipes are expressed as ionic nutrient components. This
    establishes the source database nutrient concept, not a physically supplied isolated
    zinc ion, metallic zinc, zinc salt or chelate. Original Boyle/Morgan2009 culture
    methods state TAP for heterotrophic/mixotrophic growth and similar medium without
    acetic acid for autotrophy, citing Harris1989; the article section does not specify
    the zinc reagent. The prior Zn2+ owner draft did preserve this conceptual distinction,
    but it is withdrawn from actionable ingredient proposals because the historical
    supplied-form bridge remains unestablished. Retain all existing ionic source identifiers
    and both occurrences; do not reconstruct a salt from the nutrient count or generic
    TAP conventions.
  details: 'All 2 original occurrences were reviewed in their complete frozen recipe
    contexts. Evidence applies to the exact preserved source label ''Zinc''; source
    component, stock, salt, hydration and charge scopes are interpreted only as stated
    in the case reasoning. No inherited hold or downstream identity authorization
    is removed. Both occurrences describe the MediaDB ionic nutrient representation.
    This review does not authorize exact identity to an experimental zinc salt/chelate
    or infer that counterions are absent. Next requirement: For an exact supplied-ingredient
    resolution, verify the original cited Harris1989 TAP/trace-element preparation
    used by Boyle2009 and its zinc salt/chelate or reagent identity. A separate explicit
    representation policy may retain the ion-level nutrient concept without claiming
    source-supplied reagent equivalence.'

    Supplier BORTECH gives the same formula and CAS20908-72-9. The bounded OLS hydrate
    search did not verify an exact tetrahydrate term; CHEBI:75832 is the anhydrous
    parent. Propose a separate CAS-identified tetrahydrate with an asymmetric parent

    a tetrahydrate concept in that record. This bounded search does not assert absence
    from all ontologies.

    CHEBI15422 describe the generic ATP molecule and cannot erase that counterion.

  area: identity
  topic: HEEDTA
  outcome: supported
  summary: UTEX modified P-IV/DAS context identifies Sigma H7154. The manufacturer
    explicitly identifies HEEDTA/HEDTA free acid, CAS150-39-0, C10H18N2O7. NLM MeSH
    M0085998 specifically denotes N-(hydroxyethyl)ethylenediaminetriacetic acid. Use
    that exact free-acid concept, not umbrella C026060 whose separate narrower concepts
    represent sodium/calcium/potassium salts and metal chelates. No salt labels are
    imported as synonyms; this is neither EDTA nor trisodium HEDTA.

    nitrate hexahydrate and six waters, resolving the old formula/CAS gap. The proposal
    preserves the flattened source text, adds the original parenthesized spelling,
    and uses cas:10294-41-4 with the closest broader MeSH cerium(III) nitrate concept
    M0319657. OLS finds an exact SNOMED substance term725783009, but SNOMED is not
    a permitted OntologySourceEnum in this frozen schema; no exact eligible term was
    found in the captured CHEBI/all-OLS name/CAS queries. NLM distinguishes narrower
    Ce(III) concept M0319657, CAS10108-73-3, from the descriptor including Ce(IV);
    the Ce(III) concept is the closer form-of parent. It is not exact hexahydrate
    identity. The flattened producer label CeNO33 x 6 H2O is retained with its original
    provenance as non-resolving REJECTED_LABEL, because loss of parentheses changes

- assessment_id: case-162
  area: identity
  topic: LaNO33 x 6 H2O
  outcome: concern
  summary: The original La(NO3)3 x6H2O, MediaDive1586 CAS10277-43-7, Sigma331937 and
    PubChem exact six-water identity agree on lanthanum(III) nitrate hexahydrate.
    Official NLM browser explicitly assigns CAS10277-43-7 to narrower MeSH concept
    M0313204, labelled lanthanide nitrate hexahydrate, under the descriptor whose
    synonyms include lanthanum nitrate. The exact concept preserves the six-water
    scope that the broader descriptor C016534 would lose. The production local adapter
    independently resolves the M concept canonical label; the proposal therefore uses
    mesh:M0313204 with CAS_RN_LOOKUP provenance and retains the CAS/form evidence.
    An OLS search returning only descriptor classes was insufficient to establish
    absence of this exact concept. The flattened producer label LaNO33 x 6 H2O is
    retained with its original provenance as non-resolving REJECTED_LABEL, because
    loss of parentheses changes literal formula stoichiometry; only the verified provider
    spelling is a resolving source alias.
  details: 'Assessment applies only to mediadive mediadive.ingredient:1586 and frozen
